open_questions: Does the Speakeasy MCP Catalog contain an exact, current Atlassian Rovo remote MCP Server entry in addition to the deprecated old external-protocol entry?
After selecting Configure Manually, does the discovered Atlassian issuer remain populated in Issuer URL?
What stable hosted outbound IP ranges, if any, are available when an organization enforces Atlassian IP allowlists?
When User Installed Apps is blocked, what exact current Atlassian Administration path approves or installs the Atlassian MCP app?

blockers.where: Opening prose: “If it does, sign in to Atlassian Administration with an organization-admin account and complete the applicable checks below.”
blockers.problem: The opening incorrectly routes third-party-app and network-egress restrictions to an organization administrator in Atlassian Administration, while the Research Dossier assigns them to a site administrator and the network/security owner respectively.
blockers.suggestion: Limit the organization-admin direction to OAuth-domain and IP-allowlist checks, then separately direct User Installed Apps failures to a site admin and strict egress filtering to the network/security owner.

blockers.problem: The requirement attributes every User Installed Apps restriction to organization-admin approval, but the Research Dossier says a site admin may need to install the Atlassian MCP app and leaves the exact approval path unresolved.
blockers.suggestion: Use a role-neutral description such as “Administrative action when OAuth domains, IP allowlists, or User Installed Apps policy restrict the connection,” or split the organization-admin and site-admin requirements.

history.revision_notes: External finding: revised the opening of external.md to limit Atlassian Administration organization-admin direction to OAuth-domain and IP-allowlist checks, while directing User Installed Apps failures to a site admin and strict egress filtering to the network/security owner. Meta finding: changed credential_setup.requirements[id=organization-policy-approval] to the role-neutral “Administrative action” wording for OAuth domains, IP allowlists, and User Installed Apps policy restrictions.

research_change.notes: AFTER adds draft-relevant setup facts: the exact hosted OAuth callback URL (`https://app.getgram.ai/mcp/remote_login_callback`) replaces the prior unknown-domain placeholder and changes the Atlassian custom-domain step; it identifies the existing catalog entry as deprecated for the old external protocol and favors the Custom remote server path unless a current Rovo entry is clearly present. It also clarifies that `*.atlassian.net` egress belongs to network/security controls and that hosted outbound IP ranges remain unknown. These deltas justify re-drafting both external.md and speakeasy.md.
